site_settings.sub_cyber: Real-world cybernetic command console. DuckyScript → Aut2Exe EXE compiler, live BLE scanner, DNS recon, localhost port sweep. All operations client-side sandboxed.
site_settings.sub_skeu: An analog command desk with brass dials, leather lining, and vacuum-tube amplifiers. Mechanical keystroke relays, physical Bluetooth proximity sweeps, DNS wiretap records, and WebRTC leakage diagnostics. Completely client-side sandboxed relays.

profile.name: Arunesh
profile.bio: Arunesh is a Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer specializing in agentic workflows, embedded inference models, and real-time telemetry processing. As the lead architect of the LENLU SC Command Deck, he designs and deploys local LLM pipelines, speech-recognition neural synthesis engines, and client-side security sandboxes optimized for low-latency tactical diagnostics.

capabilities.title: DuckyScript 3.0 Interpreter
capabilities.desc: Supports recursion limits, function declarations, multi-arg loops, execution speeds delay metrics calibration, and full syntax validation.

capabilities.title: Neural Generative Synth
capabilities.desc: Asynchronous integration with leading LLMs using CORS proxy support warnings, speech translation API, and direct code ingestion channels.

capabilities.title: Web Bluetooth BLE Telemetry
capabilities.desc: Active scan triggers to detect surrounding wireless nodes, capturing RSSI metrics and streaming structured base64 data to our frontend displays.

capabilities.title: GeoIP and Network Jitter API
capabilities.desc: Pinpoint local ISP parameters to evaluate latency drops, round-trip connection stability checks, and Cloudflare deauth test mocks.

capabilities.title: Local Sockets Sweep
capabilities.desc: Asynchronously pings common developer host ports (like 80, 443, 3000, 8080) to detect open network server channels on local environments.

capabilities.title: Acoustic Audio Analyser
capabilities.desc: Leverages the Web Audio API FFT analyser node to parse sound wave frequencies, driving dynamic 2D canvas spectrum visualizations.
